title: DEFAULT: autonomous loop builds in isolated branches, holds ALL merges for human approval
summary: User's standing preference (2026-06-07): the self-scheduling loop should run autonomously (build problem→attempts→judge subtrees overnight) but NEVER merge to main without the user's explicit approval. Encoded as the default in three skills: (1) self-learn-judge — HOLD-MERGE MODE: pick winner, record verdict tagged awaiting_merge:true with winner_branch, preserve all attempt branches/worktrees, set problem done with a '⏸ MERGE PENDING — <branch>' summary, complete the judge WITHOUT request_guidance so the loop keeps building; no merge. (2) orch-loop — every code-producing worker builds in an isolated branch+worktree off the code repo (~/.claude/orchestrator), commits, and complete_task→done (required so judges unblock); never edits live checkout, never merges. (3) self-learn-planner — build attempt task NODES + judge blocked_by them, do NOT branch_task (workers self-create worktrees off the code repo per finding #1), prefer building over escalating. Config flag overlay.config.auto_merge (default false) gates the legacy auto-merge path. The single human gate is the merge: morning review = find verdicts with awaiting_merge:true / tasks whose summary starts with ⏸ MERGE PENDING, diff the branch, merge if approved. Loop is bounded by maxIterations so it stops cleanly.
